_note: Electoral districts (provinces). REGION_WEIGHT scales a region's seats against its population: Alinni gets fewer seats than its people would earn, part of the minority's disenfranchisement. DISTRICTS: overrides by province name or id: seats (fixed), name (rename), lean (a local lean per axis, e.g. {"society": -15}). Yamlin Proper and Northern Cranbia, the countryside of two city regions, lean nationalist and right (designer, November 2026). Middle Cranbia was merged into Cranebo in tools/build_map.py (MERGE).
